Let's read them, sound by sound!

segs.vis: 七個字的第一個字母放大發光
segs.text: Days of the week are special names. They always start with a capital letter.
星期的英文是專有名詞，第一個字母一定要大寫。

segs.vis: 螢幕寫 sunday，Cosmo 思考 P06
segs.text: Is this right? Small s, sunday?

segs.vis: s 變大寫 S＋打勾，Nova 空中寫字 P09
segs.text: No! We need a capital S. Sunday!
We can write the days in a short way. Take the first three letters, and add a dot.
縮寫就是取前三個字母，再加上一個點。
Sunday, S, U, N. Sun. Monday, M, O, N. Mon. Tuesday, T, U, E. Tue.
Wednesday, W, E, D. Wed. Thursday, T, H, U. Thu.
Friday, F, R, I. Fri. Saturday, S, A, T. Sat.
別忘了，縮寫的第一個字母也要大寫，最後要加點喔！
Let's say all seven days together!
Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday!
Your turn! Say all seven days.
